diagrams.title: **The journey in this section
diagrams.caption: **The journey in this section.** Each step adds one ability. Steps 1 to 4 make the model *know* more. Step 5 is different in kind: the model starts *doing* things.

diagrams.title: **The four walls around a plain LLM, and the two doors out
diagrams.caption: **The four walls around a plain LLM, and the two doors out.** RAG fixes the first three walls by feeding the model fresh, private information. Agents fix the fourth by letting the model use tools to act.

diagrams.title: **Retrieve, augment, generate
diagrams.caption: **Retrieve, augment, generate.** The retrieval step finds the fact; the augment step glues it to the question; the model only has to read and phrase the answer. Swap the news database for your HR policies and the same three steps answer "how many leave days do I get?".

diagrams.title: **Seven steps, two phases
diagrams.caption: **Seven steps, two phases.** Steps 1 to 4 build a searchable "memory" of your documents. Steps 5 to 7 use it for each question. The dashed border on step 6 means it is optional.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 500" aria-label="The RAG pipeline in seven steps across two phases. Preparation: load, chunk, embed, store. Answering: the question is used to retrieve the nearest chunks from the store, optionally filter and rerank them, then generate the answer." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <text x="30" y="40" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Prepare your knowledge: done once, and again whenever documents change</text>

        <text x="50" y="168" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">database rows</text>

        <text x="586" y="168" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">vector of numbers</text>

        <circle cx="864" cy="108" r="15" class="paper" style="fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2"></circle><text x="864" y="114" text-anchor="middle" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">4</text>

        <text x="318" y="396" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">Embed the question, find</text>
        <text x="318" y="418" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">the top-k nearest chunks</text>

        <text x="620" y="365" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Filter and rerank</text>

diagrams.title: **Lost in the middle
diagrams.caption: **Lost in the middle.** A fact buried in the middle of a huge block is the one most likely to be missed. Chunking means each piece is short, so there is barely a "middle" to get lost in.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 330" aria-label="Lost in the middle: the chance a model uses a fact is high when the fact is at the start or the end of a long input, and lowest when it is in the middle." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <line x1="90" y1="262" x2="950" y2="262" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></line>
      <line x1="90" y1="262" x2="90" y2="30" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text x="520" y="300" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">Where the fact sits inside one long input</text>
      <text x="120" y="286" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">start</text><text x="520" y="286" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">middle</text><text x="920" y="286" text-anchor="end" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">end</text>
      <text x="60" y="150" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" transform="rotate(-90 60 150)" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">Chance the model uses it</text>
      <path d="M120 66 C 300 248, 740 248, 920 72" fill="none" stroke="#2958C4" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"></path>
      <circle cx="122" cy="68" r="11" class="fill-tool" style="fill:#0B7F73"></circle>
      <circle cx="918" cy="74" r="11" class="fill-tool" style="fill:#0B7F73"></circle>
      <circle cx="520" cy="202" r="12" class="fill-risk" style="fill:#C4344F"></circle>
      <text x="142" y="62" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">remembered</text>
      <text x="898" y="56" text-anchor="end" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">remembered</text>
      <text x="520" y="168" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-risk" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#8E1F35;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">often overlooked</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **From words to coordinates
diagrams.caption: **From words to coordinates.** The values shown are illustrative. What matters is that similar meanings produce nearby vectors, so "searching by meaning" becomes "finding the nearest points".
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 230" aria-label="A text chunk goes into an embedding model, which outputs a vector of about one thousand numbers." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="20" y="50" width="300" height="130" rx="14" class="bx" style="fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2"></rect>
      <text x="40" y="84" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Chunk of text</text>
      <text x="40" y="114" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Every full-time employee</text>
      <text x="40" y="136" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">gets 24 days of paid</text>
      <text x="40" y="158" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">leave per year…”</text>
      <path d="M320 115 H388" class="ln-data" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="392" y="60" width="300" height="110" rx="16" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="542" y="104" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Embedding model</text>
      <text x="542" y="134" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">e.g. Titan Text Embeddings v2</text>
      <path d="M692 115 H760" class="ln-data" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="764" y="50" width="316" height="130" rx="14" class="bx" style="fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2"></rect>
      <text x="784" y="84" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Vector (its meaning, as numbers)</text>
      <text x="784" y="118" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:15px">[0.021, -0.113, 0.087,</text>
      <text x="784" y="140" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:15px"> 0.442, -0.019, … ]</text>
      <text x="784" y="166" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">1,024 numbers by default</text>
    </svg>
